PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001" -TimeoutSec 10 -UseBasicParsing; $found = @\(\); if \($r.Content -match "OMS"\) { $found += "Header/Logo OMS" }; if \($r.Content -match "Construisons"\) { $found += "Section Hero" }; if \($r.Content -match "Gros"\) { $found += "Section Services" }; if \($r.Content -match "Devis"\) { $found += "CTA Devis" }; if \($r.Content -match "2026|2025"\) { $found += "Footer annee" }; $found -join "`n" } catch { $_ })

PowerShell($pages = @\("/services", "/realisations", "/a-propos", "/contact"\); foreach \($p in $pages\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001$p" -TimeoutSec 10 -UseBasicParsing; "✅ $p — $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "❌ $p — $_" } })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $pages = @\("/", "/services", "/realisations", "/a-propos", "/contact"\); foreach \($p in $pages\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001$p" -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing; "✅ $p — OK" } catch { "❌ $p — $_" } })
